column1: # Every DBC table the 3.3.5a client (build 12340) loads, one row per table loader.
# 237 load at startup (`loaded_by=startup`); the rest load on demand.
# columns / row_size are the loader's literal header checks: a file of any other width is a fatal error.
# game_table is the slot a gt table is read through.
# readers counts the functions that read the table past its load. It is a floor: a read through a
# computed pointer is not seen. lua lists the Lua bindings (`:Name` a widget method) and opcodes the
# incoming opcodes whose handler reads the table directly; a reader reached through a helper is
# 241 tables; 10 with no reader: the client loads them and never reads them.
